question: SFGS 80% 担保产品申请条件有哪些
answer:
根据【参考资料】，SFGS（中小企融资担保计划）80%担保产品的**申请条件**中，资料明确说明的内容如下（面向普通借款人）：

✅ **已确认的申请条件（直接来自资料）：**  
1. **申请人身份要求**：必须是**香港注册的中小企业（SME）**。  
　　→ 虽然资料未明确定义“中小企业”具体标准（如员工人数或年营业额），但整个计划名称及上下文均指向“中小企”，且所有产品（包括80%产品）统一适用于SME，此为计划基本适用对象 [资料1]。

2. **贷款用途**：须用于**企业业务经营**（如营运资金、设备购置、业务拓展等）。  
　　→ 资料虽未逐条罗列允许用途，但强调“Enterprise should contact the Lenders to apply for the loan or credit facility”，且整份文件语境均为支持企业融资需求；所有担保产品均属“SME Financing Guarantee Scheme”，用途天然限定于企业经营活动 [资料1]。

3. **担保比例与贷款结构**：  
　　- HKMCI为合资格贷款提供**最高80%本金担保**；  
　　- 借款人需自担剩余20%风险（即银行可要求借款人提供至少20%的首期或抵押/信用支持）[资料1, 表格页]。

4. **最大贷款额度**：  
　　- 单一企业（含其附属公司及关联实体）在任何时点，通过80%产品获得的担保贷款总额**上限为港币1200万元**（HK$12,000,000*）；  
　　- 此额度**包含已融资支付的“一次性前期担保费”**（Single Upfront Guarantee Fee）[资料3]。

5. **担保费承担方式与费率范围**：  
　　- 年度担保费率为**贷款金额或授信额度的0.5%–3.2%**（视银行政策及个案风险而定）；  
　　- 可选择**按年缴付**，或对定期贷款选择**一次性前期缴付**（该笔费用本身可计入贷款金额内融资）[资料1]。

❌ **现有资料无法确认的内容（不可推断，必须如实说明）：**  
- 具体的企业成立年限要求（例如是否必须营运满1年/2年）；  
- 是否要求有香港本地实际经营地址或缴税记录；  
- 是否需提供财务报表、银行流水、税务报表等**具体文件清单**；  
- 是否要求企业主个人担保、抵押品类型或最低信用评分；  
- 银行内部审批所需**办理时效（如从申请到放款天数）**；  
- “中小企业”的官方定义（如员工数≤50人、年营业额≤HK$800万等量化标准）；  
- 是否接受非香港永久居民或新来港人士作为企业负责人申请。

⚠️ 温馨提示：以上条件均以银行（Lender）最终审核为准。HKMCI不直接受理申请，借款人**必须通过参与计划的银行提交申请**，由银行开展尽职调查并决定是否递交至HKMCI [资料1]。

信息来源：[资料1]、[资料3]

SME Financing Guarantee Scheme - 90% Guarantee Product

Press Releases

06 Dec 2019

SME Financing Guarantee Scheme - 90% Guarantee Product

HKMC Insurance Limited (HKMCI), a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation Limited, announces that, with the approval of the funding by the Finance Committee of the Legislative Council today, the 90% Guarantee Product under the SME Financing Guarantee Scheme (SFGS) will be introduced. The 90% Guarantee Product aims to provide additional support to smaller-sized enterprises, businesses with relatively less operating experience, as well as professionals seeking to set up their own practices, to obtain financing.

A total of HK$33 billion will be guaranteed by the Government for the 90% Guarantee Product. Each eligible enterprise can obtain guarantee for term loans up to HK$6 million, with a maximum guarantee period of five years and the same guarantee fee rate as the existing 80% Guarantee Product. The HKMCI is actively undertaking the final preparatory work with the lenders, and strives to start receiving applications before the end of this year. The application period will last until 30 June 2022.

Further announcement will be made upon finalisation of the date of receiving applications. For public enquiries, please call the SFGS Hotline at 2536 0392.

answer:
现有资料中**未提及“SFGS_09/2024”这一文件编号**，也未说明该编号对应的具体政策名称、内容、生效日期或适用范围。

- 【资料1】【资料2】【资料3】均未将任何政策、操作指引或公告与该编号关联；  
- 目前可确认的SFGS相关产品仅有：

  • 90% Guarantee Product（申请截止日：2026年3月31日）；

  • 已终止的100% Personal Loan Guarantee Scheme（PLGS）（申请截止日：2023年4月30日）。

# The SME Financing Guarantee Scheme

the SME Financing Guarantee Scheme (SFGS) and a further one-year extension of the principal moratorium arrangement. HKMC Insurance Limited (HKMCI) 1 , which is responsible for implementing and administering the SFGS, has completed the preparatory work with participating lending institutions and launched the relevant new measures in November.

The application periods for the 80% and 90% Guarantee Products under the SFGS will end on 31 March 2028 and 31 March 2026 respectively. As at the end of November 2025, these two products have benefited around 25,000 enterprises and around 400,000 employees. Borrowing enterprises may submit loan applications to the lending institutions according to their business needs. While processing times vary depending on the specific circumstances of each case, data in recent years show that after the HKMCI received complete application documents from the lending institutions, more than 80% of applications were approved within 10 working days, and over 60% could even be approved within 3 working days, thus effectively helping SMEs cope with cash-flow pressures.

The Special 100% Loan Guarantee for SMEs and the 100% Personal Loan Guarantee Scheme (PLGS) for individuals who have lost their main recurring incomes from employment in Hong Kong during the epidemic were both time-limited special support measures. Their application periods ended on 31 March 2024 and 30 April 2023 respectively, and the two measures provided timely and effective support to SMEs and individuals who had lost their jobs and income, benefiting approximately 40,000 enterprises (involving more than 400,000 employees) and over 59,000 applicants respectively.

Regarding the SFGS, beneficiary SMEs span a wide range of industrial and business segments, including retail, catering, services, and even innovative technology. Whether family-run small businesses, long-established brands, start-ups, or relatively large-scale enterprises, they are able to weather the challenges of an economic downturn through the support of guaranteed loans.

Although the application periods for the Special 100% Loan Guarantee and the PLGS have ended, substantial debt repayment and recovery work remains as a substantial portion of loans remains within a total repayment period of up to 10 years. The HKMCI has been working closely with lending institutions to manage default cases appropriately. Specifically, lending institutions would first follow up with the borrowing enterprises/borrowers to understand their overall financial and funding conditions, and discuss feasible repayment plans with those borrowing enterprises/borrowers who are willing and able to repay so that they can continue to operate/maintain a normal life as soon as possible under the debt restructuring arrangement and gradually resume normal repayments.

At the same time, lending institutions would assess the asset positions of both the borrowing enterprises/borrowers and the relevant guarantors. Where repayment agreements cannot be reached, the borrowing enterprises/borrowers refuse to cooperate, or there are reasonable grounds to believe the borrowing enterprises/borrowers are deliberately evading repayment obligations, such as making asset transfers, lending institutions will, in accordance with their policies and usual commercial practices, consider taking appropriate recovery or legal actions against the borrowers and guarantors, with the objective of recovering debts in the most effective way to minimise losses to the Government.

question: SFGS 80% 担保和 90% 担保产品的区别
answer:
SFGS（中小企融资担保计划）的 **80% 担保产品** 和 **90% 担保产品** 是香港特区政府支持中小企业的两项主要信贷担保工具。根据现有资料，它们在以下方面有明确区别：

---

✅ **已确认的区别（资料直接支持）：**

1. **政府担保比例不同**  
   - 80% 担保产品：HKMCI（香港按揭证券公司旗下保险公司）为贷款本金提供 **最高80% 的担保**；  
   - 90% 担保产品：HKMCI 提供 **最高90% 的担保**。  
   → 这意味着银行对借款人违约风险的承担比例更低（90%产品下银行仅承担10%，80%产品下承担20%），理论上可能提升放款意愿。

2. **最高可担保贷款额度不同**  
   - 80% 担保产品：单个借款人（含其附属公司/关联实体）**最高可获担保总额为 HK$12,000,000**（任何时候点）；  
   - 90% 担保产品：**最高可获担保总额为 HK$18,000,000**（任何时候点），且该额度**包含所有80%和90%担保产品项下的贷款**。  
   → 注意：若企业同时使用80%和90%产品，总担保额不能超过 HK$18,000,000；但若还使用了50%/60%/70%产品，则适用更低的额度上限（见资料1末注）。

3. **目标支持对象略有侧重（政策定位）**  
   - 90% 担保产品明确面向：  
     • 规模更小的企业；  
     • 营业经验相对较少的企业；  
     • 正在创业设立执业机构的专业人士（如医生、律师、会计师等）。  
   → 80% 产品未在资料中说明特定目标群体，属更通用型产品。

4. **宽限期（只付息期）长度不同**  
   - 80% 担保产品：借款人可申请 **最多前6个月只付利息、不还本金**；  
   - 90% 担保产品：借款人可申请 **最多前12个月只付利息、不还本金**。  
   → 两者均要求剩余期限内按月分期还本付息，且**担保期不会因宽限期而延长**。

5. **币种灵活性不同**  
   - 80% 担保产品：贷款可**以港元或外币计价**；  
   - 90% 担保产品：贷款**仅限以港元计价**。  
   → 若需外币融资（如美元采购），80%产品更适用。

6. **担保费计算方式相同，但具体费率未列明**  
   - 两类产品均注明：“担保费可透过相关贷款一并融资”，并可通过 HKMC 官网担保费计算器估算；  
   - 资料2明确指出：90%产品“**担保费率与现有80%产品相同**”。  
   → 但**具体费率数值（如年化多少%）、是否一次性收取、是否可分摊等，资料中未提供**。

❌ **现有资料无法确认的内容（请勿自行推断）：**  
- 两种产品的**实际审批通过率或银行偏好**；  
- 是否存在**不同申请资格门槛**（如成立年限、盈利要求、行业限制等）；  
- **担保费具体金额或计算公式**（例如是否按担保额×年费率×年数）；  
- **申请所需文件清单**（资料仅提示“银行可要求提供支持文件”，未列明）；  
- **办理时效（从申请到放款需多久）**；  
- **担保有效期（即“担保期”具体最长几年）** —— 资料2提到90%产品“最高担保期为五年”，但80%产品未说明；资料3仅提“于担保期内分期还款”，未写明上限年限。

---

📌 温馨提示：

Press Releases

06 Dec 2019

SME Financing Guarantee Scheme - 90% Guarantee Product

HKMC Insurance Limited (HKMCI), a wholly-owned subsidiary of The Hong Kong Mortgage Corporation Limited, announces that, with the approval of the funding by the Finance Committee of the Legislative Council today, the 90% Guarantee Product under the SME Financing Guarantee Scheme (SFGS) will be introduced. The 90% Guarantee Product aims to provide additional support to smaller-sized enterprises, businesses with relatively less operating experience, as well as professionals seeking to set up their own practices, to obtain financing.

A total of HK$33 billion will be guaranteed by the Government for the 90% Guarantee Product. Each eligible enterprise can obtain guarantee for term loans up to HK$6 million, with a maximum guarantee period of five years and the same guarantee fee rate as the existing 80% Guarantee Product. The HKMCI is actively undertaking the final preparatory work with the lenders, and strives to start receiving applications before the end of this year. The application period will last until 30 June 2022.

Further announcement will be made upon finalisation of the date of receiving applications. For public enquiries, please call the SFGS Hotline at 2536 0392.

question: 中小企业最高可以申请多少贷款额度 担保产品上限是多少
answer:
根据您提供的【参考资料】，关于中小企业在“中小企融资担保计划”（SME Financing Guarantee Scheme, SFGS）下可申请的**最高贷款额度**和**担保产品上限**，现说明如下：

✅ **已确认信息（资料直接支持）：**  
1. **担保比例上限（即担保产品上限）明确列出：**  
   - 80% 担保产品：HKMCI 最高为贷款本金的 **80%** 提供担保；  
   - 90% 担保产品：HKMCI 最高为贷款本金的 **90%** 提供担保；  
   - 特别100%贷款担保（Special 100% Loan Guarantee）：HKMCI 最高为贷款本金的 **100%** 提供担保。  
   → 这是该计划下**最高的担保比例上限**，即担保产品本身的设计上限为 **100%**。

2. **单笔贷款/设施（Facility）的最高整体利率有明确上限（间接反映额度受控逻辑）：**  
   - 截至2024年9月23日，整体年利率上限为：  
     • 营业历史超3年者：**8%**；  
     • 营业历史≤3年者：**10%**。  
   （注：利率上限不等于贷款额度上限，但体现监管对融资成本的刚性约束）

❌ **现有资料无法确认的内容：**  
- **单笔贷款的最高金额（即“最高可贷额度”）**：  
  【资料1】和【资料2】均未提及任何具体数字（如500万港元、1000万港元等），也未说明是否按企业年营业额、资产规模或行业设定分级额度。  
- **企业累计可获担保贷款总额上限（如“同一企业最多可担保3笔”或“总额不超过X万港元”）**：  
  资料中无相关表述。  
- **是否设最低贷款额、币种限制（如仅限港元）、或跨境用途是否被允许**：  
  资料仅说明“贷款用途不得用于偿还旧债”，且限定用于“购置工商业物业/设备”或“一般营运资金”，但未明确是否支持跨境经营场景下的外币贷款或境外支付用途。

📌 温馨提示：  
- “担保比例” ≠ “银行最终批出的贷款额”。实际贷款额度由**放款银行（Lender）独立审批**，HKMCI仅就银行批准的贷款本金按约定比例提供担保。  
- 是否获批、批多少，取决于银行对企业的信用评估、抵押安排、现金流及还款能力判断——担保计划本身不承诺放款，只降低银行风险。

请务必在正式申请前，向您拟合作的参与银行客户经理确认：  
① 该行当前接受的SFGS贷款单笔/总额度政策；  
② 是否支持您的具体跨境经营用途（如向东南亚供应商付款、境外仓租等）；  
③ 实际执行的整体利率、手续费及担保费结构。

question: 我公司香港注册 年营业额 5000 万港币 去年利润 800 万 想申请 SFGS 担保贷款 大概能贷多少 还需要补充哪些财务证明文件
answer:
根据您提供的信息（香港注册公司、年营业额5000万港币、去年利润800万港币），结合【参考资料】中关于「中小企融资担保计划」（SFGS）的官方说明，为您分点清晰解答如下：

✅ **已确认的贷款额度（最高可贷金额）**  
SFGS 提供三类担保产品，对应不同最高贷款额度（“Maximum Facility Amount”），均以「任何时点」（at any point of time）为计算基准，且**已包含担保费**：

1. **80% 担保产品**：最高 **HK$12,000,000**  
2. **90% 担保产品**：最高 **HK$18,000,000**（含已获批的80%/90%担保贷款）  
3. **Special 100% 贷款担保**：最高 **HK$8,000,000**（同样含已获批的80%/90%担保贷款）  

⚠️ 注意：  
- 上述额度是**硬性上限**，并非自动获批金额；实际获批额由银行（Lender）根据企业还款能力审定。  
- 若贵司及其子公司/关联实体已使用过80%或90%担保产品，则后续申请将**合并计算总额度**，不可突破HK$18,000,000（对90%产品）或HK$8,000,000（对Special 100%产品）。  
- Special 100%产品**不占用**80%/90%产品的额度上限（即：可同时持有Special 100%贷款 + 其他担保贷款，只要各自不超过其专属上限）[资料1, p.3]。

✅ **已确认的申请资格（贵司基本符合）**  
- ✅ 是香港注册企业（公司/独资/合伙等），且持续按《商业登记条例》（第310章）登记 → 符合[资料1, p.3 (a)]  
- ✅ 营业满一年（“at least one year in Hong Kong as at application date”）→ 若贵司已运营≥12个月，即满足；若不足，则不适用80%/90%产品（但Special 100%产品仅需营业满3个月且受疫情影响，见下文）  
- ❓ **Special 100%产品额外条件（如拟申请此项）**：  
  - 需在2022年3月31日前已在港营业满3个月；  
  - 且须在2020年2月后任一月份，销售额较参考期（2019年1月–2022年3月内任一前季度）**下降≥30%** [资料1, p.4]。  
  → 若贵司近年经营稳健、无显著销售下滑，可能**不符合Special 100%产品资格**，但仍可申请80%/90%产品。

❌ **现有资料无法确认的内容**  
以下关键信息在【参考资料】中**未提供**，需向银行或HKMC进一步核实：  
- ❌ **实际可贷金额的具体计算方式**：资料仅给出上限（如HK$12M/HK$18M），但未说明银行如何基于营业额5000万、利润800万等财务数据核定具体放款额（例如是否采用收入倍数、利润覆盖倍数、现金流测算等模型）。  
- ❌ **所需财务证明文件清单**：资料仅泛泛提示“Lender shall request the Borrower to provide supporting documents where appropriate”（银行视情况要求支持文件）[资料2, p.2]，但**未列明具体文件类型**（如审计报告、报税表、银行流水、销售合同等）。  
- ❌ **利率、担保费率、还款期限、审批时效**：所有费用与流程细节均未在参考资料中出现。  
- ❌ **是否接受未经审计的财务报表**：资料未说明对财务数据的审计要求。

📌 温馨提示：  
- 您可先访问 HKMC 官网担保费计算器（www.hkmc.com.hk）估算担保费；  
- 所有最终额度、文件要求、审批结果，须以**参与计划的银行客户经理**评估为准。

信息来源：[资料1]、[资料2]

question: 申请 SFGS 担保贷款的完整流程是什么 从提交申请到拿到钱大概要多久
answer:
申请 SFGS（中小企融资担保计划）担保贷款的完整流程及时间预估如下，面向**普通借款人（即香港本地中小企业主或个体经营者）**，所有信息均严格依据【参考资料】中明确说明的内容整理：

---

### ✅ 一、完整申请流程（共3个核心阶段）

#### **第1步：向参与银行（PL）提交贷款申请**
- 您需**主动联系一家已加入SFGS的参与银行（Participating Lender, PL）** 提出贷款申请；
- 银行会进行客户尽职调查（customer due diligence）、审核您的资格与还款能力，并评估是否支持该笔贷款；
- 若银行同意支持，您需与银行**共同填写申请表格**，并提供银行要求的所有支持文件（资料未列明具体文件清单，仅说明“necessary supporting documents”）；
- 银行将连同拟签发的《贷款要约函》（facility letter）*（注：Special 100%产品除外，无需提交）* 及全部材料，一并提交给**HKMC Insurance Limited（HKMCI）** 审核。

> 🔍 补充说明：  
> - “参与银行”须是经HKMCI认可的授权机构（如持牌银行、限制牌照银行或存款公司）；  
> - 您**不能直接向HKMCI申请**，必须通过银行作为中介；  
> - 现有资料**未列出参与银行名单、不说明如何查询哪家银行在受理、也不说明借款人需准备哪些具体文件（如营业执照、报税单、银行流水等）** → **现有资料无法确认**。

#### **第2步：HKMCI审核与批准（含两种路径）**
HKMCI收到完整材料后，按以下任一路径处理：

| 路径类型 | 适用情形 | HKMCI处理时效 | 关键结果 |
|----------|-----------|----------------|------------|
| **审批原则（Approval-in-Principle）** | 多数常规申请 | **约3个工作日内**发出《结果通知书》 | 银行据此准备签约文件，供您签署 |
| **直通式审批（Straight-Through Approval）** | 符合条件的简化申请（资料未定义标准） | 同上，约3个工作日内出结果 | 后续步骤更快 |

> ⚠️ 注意：  
> - 资料明确指出：“**超过80%的申请在HKMCI收到完整文件后10个工作日内获批，超60%可在3个工作日内获批**”（[资料2]）；  
> - 但该时效**从银行提交“完整申请文件”起算**，不包含您准备材料、银行内部审批、面签等前置时间；  
> - **现有资料无法确认银行内部初审需多久、您配合签署耗时多久、以及是否需要面签或公证等环节。**

#### **第3步：签约放款 & 担保生效**
- 您在银行指导下签署全部贷款及担保相关文件；
- 银行将已签署文件和必要支持材料**再次提交HKMCI**，以完成担保函（Guarantee）的正式签发 → **约2个工作日内完成**（[资料1]）；
- **担保费支付后，担保才正式生效**：
  - 担保费可选择**每年缴纳**，或一次性付清（Single Upfront Guarantee Fee）；
  - 若选一次性付款，银行**可从贷款本金中直接扣除该费用后，再将剩余金额发放给您**（[资料1][资料3]）；
- **只有HKMCI收到担保费后，担保才生效，银行方可放款**（[资料1]）。

> 💡 小贴士：  
> - 担保费率取决于企业运营年限：  
>   • 在港经营超3年：**最高0.36% / 年**；  
>   • 在港经营≤3年：**最高0.45% / 年**；  
> - 特别说明：**Special 100% Loan Guarantee（已于2024年3月31日截止申请）不收取担保费，也无此“付费生效”环节**（[资料1][资料3]）。

---

### ⏱️ 二、从提交申请到拿到钱：大概需要多久？

根据资料可确认的时间节点汇总：

| 阶段 | 最短可能耗时 | 最长常见耗时 | 依据来源 |
|------|----------------|----------------|------------|
| 银行初审 + 您配合准备/签署文件 | ❓ 未说明 | ❓ 未说明 | **现有资料无法确认** |
| HKMCI审批（自银行提交完整材料起） | **约3个工作日**（60%案例） | **10个工作日以内**（80%案例） | [资料2] |
| HKMCI签发担保函（审批通过后） | **约2个工作日** | — | [资料1] |
| 担保费支付 + 银行放款 | 即时（若担保费已扣或到账） | — | [资料1] |

✅ **因此，在银行材料一次齐全、审批顺利、您及时配合签字缴费的前提下，从银行向HKMCI提交完整申请起，最快约5–6个工作日可完成全部流程并放款。**  
❌ 但**从您首次联系银行到最终收款的总时长，现有资料未提供任何数据或范围** → **现有资料无法确认**。

---

### 📌 温馨提示（务必注意）
- SFGS目前仍在运行，但不同担保产品的申请截止日不同：
  - **80% Guarantee Product**：截至 **2028年3月31日**；  
  - **90% Guarantee Product**：截至 **2026年3月31日**；  
  - **Special 100% Loan Guarantee 已于2024年3月31日终止**（[资料2][资料3]）。
- 所有操作必须通过参与银行进行，HKMCI不直接受理个人申请；
- 最新官方信息请查阅：https://www.hkmc.com.hk/eng/our_business/sme_financing_guarantee_scheme.html（[资料5]）。

---

⚠️ **重要提示**：本回答仅基于您提供的参考资料整理，不构成法律、税务或信贷建议。实际申请前，请务必向您选择的参与银行客户经理确认最新要求、所需文件清单、利率、还款安排及担保费计算方式。如有复杂情况（如信用记录异常、初创企业、跨境关联等），建议同步咨询专业会计师或金融顾问。

信息来源：[资料1]、[资料2]、[资料3]、[资料5]

# The SME Financing Guarantee Scheme

the SME Financing Guarantee Scheme (SFGS) and a further one-year extension of the principal moratorium arrangement. HKMC Insurance Limited (HKMCI) 1 , which is responsible for implementing and administering the SFGS, has completed the preparatory work with participating lending institutions and launched the relevant new measures in November.

The application periods for the 80% and 90% Guarantee Products under the SFGS will end on 31 March 2028 and 31 March 2026 respectively. As at the end of November 2025, these two products have benefited around 25,000 enterprises and around 400,000 employees. Borrowing enterprises may submit loan applications to the lending institutions according to their business needs. While processing times vary depending on the specific circumstances of each case, data in recent years show that after the HKMCI received complete application documents from the lending institutions, more than 80% of applications were approved within 10 working days, and over 60% could even be approved within 3 working days, thus effectively helping SMEs cope with cash-flow pressures.

The Special 100% Loan Guarantee for SMEs and the 100% Personal Loan Guarantee Scheme (PLGS) for individuals who have lost their main recurring incomes from employment in Hong Kong during the epidemic were both time-limited special support measures. Their application periods ended on 31 March 2024 and 30 April 2023 respectively, and the two measures provided timely and effective support to SMEs and individuals who had lost their jobs and income, benefiting approximately 40,000 enterprises (involving more than 400,000 employees) and over 59,000 applicants respectively.

Regarding the SFGS, beneficiary SMEs span a wide range of industrial and business segments, including retail, catering, services, and even innovative technology. Whether family-run small businesses, long-established brands, start-ups, or relatively large-scale enterprises, they are able to weather the challenges of an economic downturn through the support of guaranteed loans.

Although the application periods for the Special 100% Loan Guarantee and the PLGS have ended, substantial debt repayment and recovery work remains as a substantial portion of loans remains within a total repayment period of up to 10 years. The HKMCI has been working closely with lending institutions to manage default cases appropriately. Specifically, lending institutions would first follow up with the borrowing enterprises/borrowers to understand their overall financial and funding conditions, and discuss feasible repayment plans with those borrowing enterprises/borrowers who are willing and able to repay so that they can continue to operate/maintain a normal life as soon as possible under the debt restructuring arrangement and gradually resume normal repayments.

At the same time, lending institutions would assess the asset positions of both the borrowing enterprises/borrowers and the relevant guarantors. Where repayment agreements cannot be reached, the borrowing enterprises/borrowers refuse to cooperate, or there are reasonable grounds to believe the borrowing enterprises/borrowers are deliberately evading repayment obligations, such as making asset transfers, lending institutions will, in accordance with their policies and usual commercial practices, consider taking appropriate recovery or legal actions against the borrowers and guarantors, with the objective of recovering debts in the most effective way to minimise losses to the Government.
